messages:
li: Heads-up team: release train freeze scheduled 2026-06-29 00:00 UTC -> 2026-07-01 23:59 UTC. This is a short, mandatory freeze to run infra migrations and run expanded canary suites.
li: Purpose: reduce risk during capacity changes and verify new kernel & batching improvements. Please avoid non-critical deploys in that window.
tom: For emergency fixes, what do we need to file?
li: Use the EXCEPTION workflow in Jira. Required fields: owner, emergency reason, risk assessment, rollback steps, test script, and approvers. Exception requests close 48h before the target deploy time.
natalie: If a security team finds a vuln, can we bypass the 48h rule?
li: Security exceptions are fast-tracked. Tag ticket with EXCEPTION+SECURITY, include CVSS/impact, and add @legal if customer data is involved. Eng-SRE will triage within 2 hours.
eng-sre: Quick note on canaries: during freeze only limited canaries allowed. Canary durations max 90m and replica size must be <=5% of traffic. Submit a canary checklist with metric thresholds (error rate, p95, qps).
tom: If a canary is approved and shows a small blip, do we pause or rollback?
eng-sre: If error_rate >3% sustained over 3m OR p95 >25% over baseline, initiate rollback. If within thresholds, keep under observation and escalate to oncall.
release-bot: [automated] Freeze active: 2026-06-29 00:00 UTC -> 2026-07-01 23:59 UTC. Exception request cutoff: 2026-06-27 00:00 UTC.
li: Exception request example (paste into Jira description):
```
- Owner: @yourname
- Component(s): runtime/api/infra
- Reason: short description of why immediate deploy is needed
- Risk: list of risks and mitigation steps
- Rollback: concrete steps with runbook links
- Tests: smoke commands + metric thresholds
- Approvals: Eng-SRE, Product, Security (if applicable)
```
natalie: Any changes for Dedicated/Private customers?
li: Yes. For Dedicated/Private releases include a customer impact section and get CS-team & Legal approval if the change touches customer data or network config. We will coordinate maintenance windows with affected accounts.
cs-team: We'll notify impacted customers and offer a short maintenance window if they opt-in.
legal: Ping us early if cross-border data or contracts are involved.
li: Last reminder: start exception threads early. We won't approve last-minute high-risk rollouts during the freeze. Thanks and ping me for questions. :hands_up:
